data.topic: DeepSeek Harness (dsh, github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, installed 0.2.2-rc.1) as a new cli-external-orchestration runtime mode that mirrors cli-pi: headless dispatch contract, providers (LLM Gateway and OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), repo-local runtime folder, skills, agents, commands, plugins and hooks to port, third-party Pi plugins to migrate or drop, MCP, deep-loop fan-out executor support, every cross-repo touch point, and the phase plan.
